outcome: postpartum blood pressure screening attendance within 10 days of delivery
cohort: The study participants were 1260 pregnant women diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) who delivered at a large public hospital in Atlanta between July 1, 2016, and June 30, 2018.
finding: Most women (86.3%) in a high-risk safety-net population with HDP did not attend a BP screening visit within 10 days of delivery, with attendance being higher for those with preeclampsia with severe features and adequate prenatal care utilization.
